draft_en.subject: Alongside the Utepo units you list with Hikvision - industrial and commercial bands
draft_en.body:
Hi Elvin,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 17 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the Utepo industrial and 4/8-port PoE switches you list with Hikvision, neutral packing, at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based, -40 to 75 C - model STI-288GPM - $78.9 USD; commercial 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-28DGGPM - $80.7; the UTP3-SW04-TP60 position, 4 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit unmanaged - STC-204GP - $24.2.

One question: which of the two bands do your Hikvision projects use more - industrial or commercial?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
